0.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_001
0.description: Find another table. This one is taken.

1.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_005
1.description: Tread softly, friend. The Temple Knights are always watching.

2.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_010
2.description: If you've questions to ask, then by all means.

8.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_061
8.description: My master was an accomplished dark knight who saved countless lives─including mine own.

9.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_062
9.description: I owed him my life, and so I pledged it to his cause. I begged him to teach me the dark arts, and he agreed, making me his first pupil. Fray would become the second shortly thereafter.

10.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_063
10.description: Heh, how different we were. I recall our master once likened me to a smoldering campfire and Fray to a frozen lake.

11.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_064
11.description: ...We knew the risks. We swore that we would have no regrets. And I...I have none.

12.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_065
12.description: All that remains is to finish what we started.

13.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_070
13.description: Recall the story of the first, who was that rarest of knights─one who held his vows sacrosanct and strove ever to walk in the Fury's grace.

14.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_071
14.description: This man good and true did what no one else had the courage to do. He passed judgment on a vile beast who had used his position in the clergy to commit unspeakable crimes.

15.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_072
15.description: To wit, he cut down the clergyman before the eyes of gods and men, ensuring that the bastard would never harm another child of the Brume again.

16.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_073
16.description: The Holy See could not abide such action, of course. He was detained and delivered unto the Tribunal. Though he won his freedom through trial by combat, he was later stripped of his titles and denounced for his deeds.

17.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_074
17.description: But rather than lament his poor fortune, he embraced it. If they would condemn him as a dark knight, then he would take it as a title.

18.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_075
18.description: He forsook the trappings of his past life, including his sigil and the shield which bore it. In its place, he came to wield something far more potent: a power born of the abyss which lies at the heart of us all.

19.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_076
19.description: A darkness which can grant us great strength...at a price.

20.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_100
20.description: You look to be in good health, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Something we can do for you?

21.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_101
21.description: Oh, don't you worry about me. I'll be right as rain soon enough. Ugh...<hex:02100103>Was there something you wanted to discuss?

22.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_102
22.description: Trouble seems to follow you wherever you go, doesn't it? And when it doesn't, you can't help but conjure it up... Anyway, how goes it?

23.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_103
23.description: Saved any more parallel worlds lately? I jest, I jest. Still, you can't blame a man for viewing such incredible claims with a measure of skepticism, can you?

24.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_104
24.description: Well, aren't we a creature of habit. Not much reason to call on us these days, yet here you are, curious to see how we're getting on.

30.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_A3_000_155
30.description: Have you any thoughts on Myste?

32.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_A3_000_157
32.description: Any thoughts on the Final Days?

33.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_160
33.description: It would seem that the countess's crusade died with her. No one has sought us out since that day.

34.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_161
34.description: Even so, I do not expect these peaceful days to last. So long as there are those who prey on the weak and helpless, there will ever be a need for knights such as we.

35.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_162
35.description: But I worry for Rielle. I cannot abandon her, yet I would not have her be a party to what will come...

36.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_163
36.description: <hex:021A020203>Her<hex:021A020103>, walk the path!? I... But she's just a...

37.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_164
37.description: ...Her life is her own, to make with it what she will. If that is her desire...then we shall discuss it.

38.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_170
38.description: I should think you know as well as I─perhaps even better. Nevertheless, if you wish to hear the tale once more, I will oblige.

39.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_171
39.description: Recall the story of the first, who was that rarest of knights─one who held his vows sacrosanct and strove ever to walk in the Fury's grace.

40.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_172
40.description: This man good and true did what no one else had the courage to do. He passed judgment on a vile beast who had used his position in the clergy to commit unspeakable crimes.

41.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_173
41.description: To wit, he cut down the clergyman before the eyes of gods and men, ensuring that the bastard would never harm another child of the Brume again.

42.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_174
42.description: The Holy See could not abide such action, of course. He was detained and delivered unto the Tribunal. Though he won his freedom through trial by combat, he was later stripped of his titles and denounced for his deeds.

43.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_175
43.description: But rather than lament his poor fortune, he embraced it. If they would condemn him as a dark knight, then he would take it as a title. He forsook the trappings of his past life, including his sigil and the shield which bore it. In its place, he came to wield something far more potent: a power born of the abyss which lies at the heart of us all. A darkness which can grant us great strength...at a price.

44.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_176
44.description: I once thought I understood this power. But then I met a band of singing moogles, and...well, I wouldn't say I'm <hex:021A020203>conflicted<hex:021A020103>. I'm rather certain that I have a greater understanding of the darkness within than some furry little shites. Still, I...I'm not quite sure what to think.

45.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_180
45.description: I try not to think about that strange boy and whatever he might have been. No one truly understands the nature of soul crystals. Not just ours, mind─I heard a rumor once upon a time about paladins and “establishing dominance.” Bollocks, eh?

46.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_181
46.description: Anyway, the one thing we know for certain is that the beings he conjured with his magick were not the spirits of the dead, but simulacra born from the memories of the living.

47.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_182
47.description: A memory is hardly a perfect accounting of past events and people. Be it consciously or subconsciously, our perceptions and feelings distort the truth.

48.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_183
48.description: Take that woman, the cousin of Ser Ignasse. She wanted to make him proud, and so he praised her efforts. Lowdy's husband and Gallien's friend were similarly shaped by the desires within their own hearts...

49.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_184
49.description: ...And no, I would rather not discuss the implications of my master soundly defeating me, yet somehow letting you win.

50.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_185
50.description: The point is, those shades spoke not the words of the dead, but the truth of our own hearts. What we bore witness to were conversations with one's self.

51.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_186
51.description: At least, that's what I'm inclined to believe. But like I said, who knows? Soul crystals are strange little things. Perhaps it's best not to dig too deep.

52.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_190
52.description: Keen to take a stroll down memory lane? I'm not sure what's prompting this, but if you insist...

53.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_191
53.description: Fray was the second pupil Ser Ompagne took after me. In our master's words, I was the smoldering campfire, whereas Fray was the frozen lake.

54.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_192
54.description: He had an unquenchable thirst for knowledge, and pursued the study of conjury in addition to our dark arts. It is well he did, for otherwise he might not have been able to sense Rielle's potential and train her as a healer.

55.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_193
55.description: "Why conjury, of all things?“ I once asked him that...

56.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_194
56.description: Fray shrugged and smiled in that way of his, and said, “When you're coming apart at the seams, who else will make you whole again?”

57.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_195
57.description: That was who he was to me. Who he was to you, though... Well. You'd know better than me.

58.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_200
58.description: Ah, that black business. I've heard the same as everyone else, which is to say not much. You and yours have been involved, I trust?

59.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_201
59.description: To the edge of the great expanse and beyond... I won't pretend to understand how any of that was even possible, but I've no doubt it played out exactly as you said.

60.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_202
60.description: And so, having saved life as we know it from oblivion, you return to your dark knight stamping grounds to see if there are any less-cosmic villains in need of a firm rebuke?

61.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_203
61.description: No rest for the righteous indeed... You'll be disappointed to hear that things are fine for the most part. Likely due to you going about playing hero.

62.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_204
62.description: Aye, not much has changed, to the frustration of many it seems. Like Rielle and her height. I swear, every day she's trying some new trick she learned about from a friend's sister's cousin.

63.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_205
63.description: Children are always so eager to grow up. I was too, I suppose. Like everyone else once was.

64.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_206
64.description: ...Listen, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I don't know if you came back hoping I had some final pearls of wisdom to share─something to put it all in perspective─but if you did, you were wrong. You know everything you need to know already.

65.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_207
65.description: You bear the sword and the promise. Memories and dreams of your own and of others. You stand for those who have no one else. That's all there is to it.

66.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRK_00300_SIDURGU_000_208
66.description: There's no path to walk or guide to follow. What strength and meaning you derive from the struggle is yours alone to find. No one else was ever the writer─it's always been your story. So go and live it.
